figurative_meaning_en: shouting at the top of one's voice
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সকলে চিল চিৎকার জুড়ে দিল।
বাচ্চারা খেলতে খেলতে চিল চিৎকার করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone in the meeting started shouting at the top of their voices.
The children are yelling loudly while playing.
note: The idiom draws from the shrill cry of the kite bird, common in Bengali rural imagery.
